ENCOUNTER:
On July 22, 2024, at approximately 1340 hours, Border Patrol Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] was conducting an inspection at a bus terminal in Port Huron, Michigan. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] approached a man seated in the waiting area, identified himself, and asked about his citizenship.
The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and that he has no immigration documents. He presented a Mexican consular identification card. He stated that he entered the United States without inspection by walking across the border near Nogales, Arizona, on or about October 1, 2021.
TRAVEL:
From Nogales he was driven to Tucson and later flew from Phoenix to Detroit.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
PROCESSING:
The subject was transported to the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Station, where his fingerprints and photograph were taken and entered into the databases. Records checks returned no criminal or immigration history.
